definitions.explanation: A person who governs or rules over a territory or people. Used in historical, political, and academic contexts to refer to those who hold governing power.

examples.japanese: {統治者|とうちしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{代|か}わった→代わる：11718_kawaru⟧。
{統治者|とうちしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: A ruler should listen to the voice of the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{統治者|とうちしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民|たみ}→民：13246_tami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{第一|だいいち}に→第一に：19173_daiichini⟧⟦{考|かんが}えていた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Looking back at history, excellent rulers put the lives of the people first.

notes:
A neutral, formal term for someone who governs. Composed of ⟦{統治|とうち}→統治：13842_touchi⟧ (governance, rule) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Unlike ⟦{支配者|しはいしゃ}→支配者：23113_shihaisha⟧, which often carries connotations of domination, {統治者|とうちしゃ} is more neutral and commonly used in academic and political writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {統治者|とうちしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: responsibility as a ruler
- {統治者|とうちしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧: the ruler's power
- ⟦{植民地|しょくみんち}→植民地：16073_shokuminchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{統治者|とうちしゃ}: colonial ruler
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{統治者|とうちしゃ}: an excellent ruler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支配者|しはいしゃ}→支配者：23113_shihaisha⟧: ruler, dominator — implies control or domination, often with a negative nuance
- ⟦{君主|くんしゅ}→君主：15298_kunshu⟧: monarch, sovereign — specifically a hereditary ruler such as a king or emperor
- {為政者|いせいしゃ}: politician in power, statesman — focuses on the person making political decisions
